hero.label: Douyin image text OCR tool
hero.title: Pull the text out of Douyin carousel images, all at once
hero.description: Douyin image posts increasingly bake lists, product specs, and tutorial steps into carousel images, with the body down to a single line. Saving a peer's product list, prices, and key points by screenshotting one image at a time is slow. MediaClaw's built-in image text extraction (OCR) reads the cover and every image, writes the text back to the collected record, and carries it through copy and export.

items.title: OCR the cover and every carousel image
items.description: A Douyin image post often has a dozen-plus carousel images. Image text extraction reads every one of them, not just the cover, pulling the product lists, prices, specs, and tutorial steps into copyable text.

why.subtitle: Why MediaClaw
why.title: Why not phone screenshots or online OCR
why.description: The three old paths each stall on something, batch, accuracy, or moving images by hand. The real problem is the same: carousel text is disconnected from the Douyin data you're already collecting.

items.title: Whole carousel at once, not one at a time
items.description: Phone screenshot text grabs one image at a time, and a dozen carousel images is a grind. Image text extraction reads the whole post and lands results in one record.

items.title: Paid model, specs stay correct
items.description: Free OCR is inconsistent; stylized and vertical text in product specs, prices, and sizes produces errors, and one wrong digit misleads your product research. Image text extraction uses a steadier paid model.

items.title: No moving images by hand
items.description: Online OCR sites make you save and upload each image yourself, back to the manual grind. Image text extraction reads the collected Douyin post directly and skips the shuffle.

items.question: Douyin image posts bake info into carousels, how do I extract the text?
items.answer: OCR the images. After collecting the Douyin post with MediaClaw, run image text extraction on it; the extension reads the cover and every carousel image and writes text back to the record for copy or export. OCR is a paid capability billed by quota; collection and CSV/Excel export are free.

items.question: Can product names, prices, and specs in a commerce carousel be batch-extracted?
items.answer: Yes. Image text extraction reads the cover plus every carousel image in a post, not just one, and writes results back as text, making it easy to compare selection and pricing side by side, with CSV or Markdown export.

items.question: Do Douyin and Xiaohongshu image posts use the same extraction flow?
items.answer: Yes. Douyin supports completing the raw data for both image and video content, and image text extraction works the same way as on Xiaohongshu, so one flow covers both platforms with no tool switching.

items.question: Where does the extracted image text live?
items.answer: It writes back to the collected record inside the extension, alongside the post's title, body, and engagement. Run OCR on the record and the result lands right there, ready to copy or export to CSV/Markdown, with no external tools.
